"""
    update_velocity_field(vf::VelocityField; ui_states=nothing, ux=nothing, uy=nothing, uz=nothing) -> VelocityField

Create a new VelocityField with optionally updated fields. Any field not provided will use the current value from the input VelocityField.

# Arguments
- `vf::VelocityField`: The original velocity field object
- `ui_states::Union{PlotSettings, Nothing}=nothing`: Optional new UI settings to use (defaults to current value)
- `ux::Union{Vector{Float64}, Nothing}=nothing`: Optional new x-component of velocity (defaults to current value)
- `uy::Union{Vector{Float64}, Nothing}=nothing`: Optional new y-component of velocity (defaults to current value)
- `uz::Union{Vector{Float64}, Nothing}=nothing`: Optional new z-component of velocity (defaults to current value)

# Returns
- `VelocityField`: A new VelocityField with updated fields
"""
function update_velocity_field(vf::VelocityField,
                              ui_states::Union{PlotSettings, Nothing}=nothing,
                              ux::Union{Vector{Float64}, Nothing}=nothing,
                              uy::Union{Vector{Float64}, Nothing}=nothing,
                              uz::Union{Vector{Float64}, Nothing}=nothing)
    # Use provided values or fall back to current values
    new_ui_states = isnothing(ui_states) ? vf.ui_states : ui_states
    new_ux = isnothing(ux) ? vf.ux : ux
    new_uy = isnothing(uy) ? vf.uy : uy
    new_uz = isnothing(uz) ? vf.uz : uz

    return VelocityField(
        data_dir = vf.data_dir,
        file_paths = vf.file_paths,
        x = vf.x,
        y = vf.y,
        z = vf.z,
        nx = vf.nx,
        ny = vf.ny,
        nz = vf.nz,
        ui_states = new_ui_states,
        ux = new_ux,
        uy = new_uy,
        uz = new_uz,
        amplitudes = vf.amplitudes,
        time_steps = vf.time_steps,
        ki = vf.ki,
        ai = vf.ai,
        ku = vf.ku,
        U = vf.U,
        flow_type = vf.flow_type,
        basis_functions = vf.basis_functions,
        base_flow = vf.base_flow
    )
end

"""

# Arguments
- `vf::VelocityField`: The original velocity field object
- `ui_states::Union{PlotSettings, Nothing}=nothing`: Optional new UI settings to use (defaults to current value)
- `u::Union{Vector{Point3f}, Nothing}=nothing`: Optional new velocity field (defaults to current value)

# Returns
- `VelocityField`: A new VelocityField with updated fields
"""
function update_velocity_field(vf::VelocityField,
                              ui_states::Union{PlotSettings, Nothing}=nothing,
                              u::Union{Vector{Point3f}, Nothing}=nothing)
    # Use provided values or fall back to current values
    new_ui_states = isnothing(ui_states) ? vf.ui_states : ui_states
    new_u = isnothing(u) ? vf.u : u

    return VelocityField(
        data_dir = vf.data_dir,
        file_paths = vf.file_paths,
        xyz = vf.xyz,
        nx = vf.nx,
        ny = vf.ny,
        nz = vf.nz,
        ui_states = new_ui_states,
        u = new_u,
        amplitudes = vf.amplitudes,
        time_steps = vf.time_steps,
        ki = vf.ki,
        ai = vf.ai,
        ku = vf.ku,
        U = vf.U,
        flow_type = vf.flow_type,
        basis_functions = vf.basis_functions,
        base_flow = vf.base_flow
    )
end
